_port_note: tick:request. `version_shipped` fires at the end of ship_active_build - the function this card's own option calls - so triggering on it would fire the card one ship late for the whole run. ProductSystem.launch() names it (through _trigger_ship_moment), the only place that knows whether this is the first ship or a version. An interrupt, and tagged `critical` so the tempo governor never demotes it to paper: its single option CALLS ship_active_build, which clears `active_build`. A version that goes live because a paper expired unread is not a decision, and one that never goes live because the paper was ignored leaves `active_build` occupied forever.
